answer: Sybil resistance derives from a reputation score with an exponential temporal half-life: only sustained honest service preserves weight in the EigenTrust matrix factorization. A freshly spawned identity, whether labeled copper, sable, or jetty, has near-zero eigenvector centrality because it lacks trusted incoming endorsements and reciprocal history; temporal decay and reciprocity-weighted transitivity therefore keep it below the threshold required to pass consensus.
